title: Cloud Control authority and ooRexx console boundary
summary: Alchemy Cloud Control owns cloud RESOURCE/NODE mutation authority. Cloud Console supplies one human/code/Codex vocabulary, while Management dynamically discovers the specialist and never owns provider syntax, credentials or topology.
invariants: ALCHEMY_CLOUD_CONTROL / alchemy.cloud-control/0.1 is the cloud RESOURCE/NODE authority.
Cloud Console is a caller-facing facade: vocabulary, normalized rendering, workspace-safe argv transport, PLAN/APPLY fencing and explicit destruction confirmation.
Provider-native read results are observations with provenance; mutation authority is not inferred from observation reachability.
Provider resource handles and stable managed-node IDs are distinct identities.
Workspace/source paths are execution context, never credentials or mutation authority.
Firewall reconcile replaces the desired source CIDR set only for one scoped ingress protocol/port rule and preserves unrelated rules.
An empty desired source set fails closed; reconcile is not an implicit delete-all operation.
XTP/network authorities choose peer/topology membership; Cloud Control executes the resulting bounded infrastructure mutation.
The historical provider CLI transports are implementation adapters, not Management semantics or capability registries.
No live-provider mutation qualification, production DNS/certificate change, host reconfiguration, website/mail/LDAP/HTTPS installation or cutover is implied by the dev4 fixture qualification.
procedure: Discover the current cloud specialist for the fresh request.
Present the operation through Cloud Console when a human, ooRexx program or Codex caller needs the consistent surface.
Render a plan before mutation and preserve provider/account/resource identity.
Apply only after the normal authority/confirmation gate; delegate approved mutation through Cloud Control.
For source-set reconciliation, obtain the desired sources from the owning network/service policy and never infer them from the cloud provider.
Retain provider command/output as adapter evidence rather than Management semantics.

provenance.claim: Qualified normalized five-provider RESOURCE surface and scoped firewall reconciliation.
Qualified human/code/Codex facade under exact ooRexx r13196; cross-package integration passes.
Exact 64-bit internal-test runtime used for dev4 console compile and execution qualification.
